**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement imposes no MFN or price-parity obligation on Sparkling. Section 11 is a plain obligation to pay the Fee Schedule fees; Section 10 imposes obligations only on Garman; and General Matters contains no parity, price-matching or "no less favourable" covenant. This matches the playbook's preferred position — no MFN burdening the Customer — so nothing needs to change.
